_readme: Consumer Rights Wizard + Rights Checker + Timeline Generator config — the ONLY file you edit to change any of the three tools. decision-tree-core.js reads 'problems', 'countries' and 'combinations' and renders screens 1-2 dynamically (no problem/country-specific code); each page supplies its own screen-3 renderer. TO ADD A PROBLEM: add its name to 'problems' and add a 'Problem|Country' entry for each country. TO ADD A COUNTRY (e.g. 'EU'): add it to 'countries' and add a 'Problem|EU' entry for each problem. Each combination may carry: directory, article, tool, template (any may be null — the Wizard result screen skips null cards); 'rights' (Refund/Replacement/Repair/Chargeback/Escalation booleans, shown by the Rights Checker); and 'timeline' (ordered steps with a label and days_from_start integer, shown by the Timeline Generator) plus 'timeline_recommended' (true when the steps are practical recommendations rather than statutory deadlines, so the UI can label them honestly). A right/deadline is set only when supported by the linked article/resource. All urls are site-absolute (leading slash).

directory.name: EDPB — EU GDPR Rights & Data Protection Authority Resources

If unresolved, compile your correspondence and file a formal complaint with your national Data Protection Authority
